rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for results achieved through sustained work.

example.english: After years of effort, this research finally came to fruition.
example.traditional: 經過幾年努力，呢個研究終於有成果喇。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 nou5 lik6 ni1 go3 jin4 gau3 zung1 jyu1 jau5 sing4 gwo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the fruition is presented as a personal achievement or accomplishment.

example.english: Building a business from scratch on his own was a remarkable achievement and the fruition of years of hard work.
example.traditional: 佢靠自己白手興家，呢份成就真係唔簡單。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1 ne1 fan2 sing4 zau6 zan1 hai6 m4 gaan2 daan1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the fruition means a dream or cherished wish coming true.

example.english: Winning an Olympic gold medal was truly the fruition of his dream.
example.traditional: 攞到奧運金牌，對佢嚟講真係夢想成真。
example.jyutping: lo2 dou3 ou3 wan6 gam1 paai4 deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 mung6 soeng2 sing4 zan1
